instruction: Kristin paid for my grocery recently as my payment cards were not working at the time. Send them the owed money with a description note "Groceries" as per my phone text conversation, and then send them a phone text message, "It is done.".
notes: Two apps (phone, venmo) as constants. supervisor.show_profile supplies the login usernames (phone number for phone, email for venmo); show_account_passwords supplies passwords. phone.search_contacts (query "Kristin") discovers Kristin's email and phone number; phone.get_current_date_and_time is required before phone.search_text_messages so the agent can identify the recent (yesterday's) message and extract the owed grocery amount (runtime amount object). venmo.create_transaction sends exactly that amount to Kristin's email with description "Groceries" (transaction-spec in :init encodes the intended record; not-already-sent precondition ensures a single transaction). phone.send_text_message of "It is done." is ordered after the payment via (money-sent kristin). supervisor.complete_task takes the two task records as non-API parameters so its precondition equals the goal conjunction, and is forced last by (task-completed).

warnings: domain: pddl-lib parser: types ['object'] of term Variable(c) are not in available types {'password', 'email', 'phone-number', 'note', 'app', 'person', 'query', 'text-message', 'amount', 'transaction', 'message', 'username', 'token'}

plan: (venmo-create-transaction kristin-email amount-owed-for-groceries venmo-token note-groceries kristin groceries-payment)
